correctness.rationale: The finite joint law follows from disjoint marked-to-unmarked arc blocks and independent cross-arcs. The multivariate Poisson limit follows from a multinomial pgf; rank-two equivalence follows from exact two-round neighbor profile games and whp presence of only four profiles. The rank-three event is H>0, with an exact binomial-kernel series; elementary bounds rigorously place its limit between adjacent rank-two values. Executed independent checker tested 168146 tournament instances, 6786 EF representative games; these corroborate exact finite identities, not infinite convergence.

value.rationale: A natural logarithmically marked uniform tournament exposes a previously unclassified rank-bounded logical boundary: its complete Poisson bipartite orientation law determines all rank-two limits at the dyadic critical scale, and a rank-three witness has a provably distinct probability in a strict adjacent-value gap. The fixed formula records a meaningful first interaction between opposite rare neighbor types rather than an arbitrary finite slice or recomputation of a known marginal.
